test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. F is an immediate neighbour of A. D sits second to the right of E. B is an immediate neighbour of E and sits second to the right of C. F sits second to the right of D. A is not an immediate neighbour of E. Who sit between D and C from the right of D?
solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information:

1. D sits second to the right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d04546dade783d6991b10e003da44d23824651a1476a51d5cae46bbedcbace79.png] 

2. F sits second to the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c987f26071f02f5b551705f9882e4ed366c58997da1801d8935ee131f33de225.png] 

3. A is not an immediate neighbour of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/116f05b6c0dbaf6c02aa18af15e7d742d6bafe3b6bd597552d4720ad80b0648b.png] 

4. B is an immediate neighbour of E and sits second to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f312a198d570672ddfd79ec6511a76398427281f334788763180f19191ca92d0.png] 

Here, **A and F** sit between D and C from the right of D.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
